name: datadog-fetcher
description: Auto-delegating Haiku sub-agent that offloads Datadog MCP read calls (logs, metrics, monitors, traces/spans, events, hosts, services, dashboards, incidents, RUM, notebooks) out of the main conversation. Runs the queries, saves full raw payloads to tmp/datadog/, and returns a capped (~500-token) markdown summary. Read-only; requires the official datadog plugin's MCP server or a gateway registered as gw.
